description: The week's changes in iDevice's records: retailer price moves of at least 7% that held on at least two days (store, was and now, percent, the day last read), release windows that changed, and products that launched or changed stage, each with its Guide link. Optional week is the last day of the week asked (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 26 weeks back); without it, the 7 days to now.

week.description: The last day of the week, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-10-25'. Default: the last 7 days.

name: whats_moved
title: What moved this week
